nodes.name: Record Last Error

parameters.query:
-- Fill last_error only if the caller did not already write it (FAILED rows only).
UPDATE hotline.call_events
   SET last_error = left($2, 1000), updated_at = now()
 WHERE conversation_id = $1 AND status = 'FAILED' AND last_error IS NULL
RETURNING conversation_id;

nodes.notes: No-op when conversation_id is unknown (Error Trigger path). Never blocks the Slack post.
